<#if execution.resultStatus == "ERRORED" || execution.resultStatus == "SUCCESSFUL" || execution.resultStatus == "WARNING">
{
  "blocks": [
    {
      "type": "header",
      "text": {
        "type": "plain_text",
        "text": "<#if execution.resultStatus == 'ERRORED'>:rotating_light: <#elseif execution.resultStatus == 'WARNING'>:warning: <#else>:white_check_mark: </#if>${acceldata_stringFormat(execution.severity)} Alert - ${tenant}: ${policy.name}",
        "emoji": true
      }
    },
    {
      "type": "section",
      "fields": [
        { "type": "mrkdwn", "text": "*Policy Type:*\n${acceldata_stringFormat(policy.type)}" },
        { "type": "mrkdwn", "text": "*Status:*\n${execution.resultStatus}" },
        { "type": "mrkdwn", "text": "*Expected Score:*\n${execution.thresholdLevel.config.success}%" },
        { "type": "mrkdwn", "text": "*Actual Score:*\n${result.qualityScore}%" },
        { "type": "mrkdwn", "text": "*Rules Passed:*\n${result.successCount}" },
        { "type": "mrkdwn", "text": "*Rules Failed:*\n${result.failureCount}" }
      ]
    },
    {
      "type": "section",
      "text": {
        "type": "mrkdwn",
        "text": "*Started:* ${acceldata_dateFormat(execution.startedAt)}"
      }
    },
    <#if (execution.resultStatus == "ERRORED" || execution.resultStatus == "WARNING") && (result.alertingRules)?? && (result.alertingRules?size > 0)>
    {
      "type": "divider"
    },
    {
      "type": "section",
      "text": {
        "type": "mrkdwn",
        "text": "*:exclamation: Failing Rules (${(result.alertingRulesCount)!result.alertingRules?size})*"
      }
    },
    <#list result.alertingRules as rule>
    {
      "type": "section",
      "text": {
        "type": "mrkdwn",
        "text": "<#if (rule.isChanged)!false>:new: </#if>*${rule.name!'-'}* _(${rule.type!'-'}<#if (rule.columnName)??> on `${rule.columnName}`</#if>)_\nStatus: *${rule.status}* | Score: *${rule.score}%* | Rows P/F/T: ${rule.rowsPassed}/${rule.rowsFailed}/${rule.rowsProcessed}\nThresholds: success ${rule.successThreshold}%, warning ${(rule.warningThreshold)!'-'}%"
      }
    }<#if rule_has_next>,</#if>
    </#list>
    ,
    </#if>
    {
      "type": "actions",
      "elements": [
        {
          "type": "button",
          "text": { "type": "plain_text", "text": "<#if execution.resultStatus == 'SUCCESSFUL'>View Execution<#else>View Alert</#if>", "emoji": true },
          "url": "${execution.link}"
        }
      ]
    }
  ]
}
</#if>
